## Overview

This project uses the **National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017–2018** to investigate the association between fermented dairy consumption and cardiometabolic health outcomes in US adults.


---

## Data sources

| File | Content | Source |
|------|---------|--------|
| `DR1IFF_J.xpt` / `DR2IFF_J.xpt` | Individual foods — 24-hour dietary recalls (Days 1 & 2) | CDC NHANES 2017–2018 *(auto-downloaded)* |
| `DR1TOT_J.xpt` / `DR2TOT_J.xpt` | Total nutrient intake summaries (Days 1 & 2) | CDC NHANES 2017–2018 *(auto-downloaded)* |
| `DEMO_J.xpt` | Demographics (age, sex, income, ethnicity) | CDC NHANES 2017–2018 |
| `BPX_J.xpt` | Blood pressure measurements | CDC NHANES 2017–2018 |
| `TCHOL_J.xpt` / `HDL_J.xpt` / `TRIGLY_J.xpt` | Serum lipids | CDC NHANES 2017–2018 |
| `BMX_J.xpt` | Body measurements (BMI, waist circumference) | CDC NHANES 2017–2018 |
| `2017-2018 FNDDS At A Glance - Foods and Beverages.xlsx` | Food classification lookup (dairy / fermented dairy flags) | USDA FNDDS 2017–2018 |

The four dietary XPT files (`DR1IFF_J`, `DR2IFF_J`, `DR1TOT_J`, `DR2TOT_J`) are **downloaded automatically** by `01_dietary_data_preparation.ipynb` from the CDC public server on first run. The remaining files must be downloaded manually from the [CDC NHANES 2017–2018 page](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/continuousnhanes/default.aspx?BeginYear=2017) and placed in `data/raw/`. All data files are excluded from this repository.

## Analysis notebook

### `notebooks/01_dietary_data_preparation.ipynb` — Dietary data preparation

[![Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/ggkuhnle/fb3pfb_nhanes/blob/main/notebooks/01_dietary_data_preparation.ipynb)

The main analytical notebook for the fermented dairy project. Processes the two 24-hour dietary recall files to produce a participant-level dataset of average daily dairy and fermented dairy intake.

**Steps:**

1. Download the four dietary XPT files from the CDC server (skipped automatically if already present).
2. Load the FNDDS food classification lookup (Excel) to identify dairy and fermented dairy food codes.
3. Load the NHANES individual foods files and classify each reported food item.
4. Aggregate dairy gram weights per participant per recall day.
5. Load and average the total nutrient intake files across two recall days.
6. Merge dairy exposure variables into the nutrient dataset.
7. Save `data/processed/nhanes_dietary_avg.csv` for use in subsequent analyses.

**Output:** `data/processed/nhanes_dietary_avg.csv`
One row per participant, containing average daily nutrient intakes and the two key exposure variables:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|------------|
| `avg_total_dairy_g` | Average grams of all dairy per day |
| `avg_fermented_dairy_g` | Average grams of fermented dairy per day |

## How to run locally

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.10+ (managed via pyenv or your system Python)
- Git

### Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ggkuhnle/fb3pfb_nhanes.git
cd fb3pfb_nhanes

python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate        # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate

pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Launch Jupyter

```bash
jupyter lab
```

Open `notebooks/01_dietary_data_preparation.ipynb`. The notebook will download the four dietary XPT files automatically on first run.
